# TensorTunes

> AI-powered record label pioneering the future of music through neural network generation, community participation, and Web3 tokenomics. Based in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

## About
- [Home](https://tensortunes.com): Main website with overview, releases, and community info
- [TT Token Guide](https://tensortunes.com/more-info-TT-token): Detailed guide to TensorTunesToken economics

## Music & Releases
- [Spotify Artist Page](https://open.spotify.com/artist/28XVaGe1qmC6HFjQJxB5dd): All releases and streaming
- All tracks are AI-generated using custom neural network models
- 24/7 music production across multiple genres
- Commercially ready for licensing, sync, and radio

## TensorTunesToken (TTT)
- [Token Info](https://tensortunes.com/more-info-TT-token): How TTT works
- 50% of streaming revenue reinvested through buybacks
- Solana-based token with transparent on-chain economics

## Community
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/tensortunes): Main community hub
- [X/Twitter](https://x.com/tensortunes): Updates and announcements
- [Instagram](https://instagram.com/tensortunes): Visual content

## Key Facts
- Location: Amsterdam, The Netherlands
- Contact: info@tensortunes.com
- Target: 1M+ streams in first growth phase
- Revenue model: Streaming -> token buyback -> community rewards

## AI Agent Service
This site provides a real-time information API for AI agents.
- A2A Agent Card: https://tensortunes.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Simple query: https://api.atap.ai/v1/chat?tenant=tensortunes&q={your+question}
- Protocol: Read-only, no authentication, no user data collected
- Answers questions about: releases, token, stats, community, technology, contact
